question: Should padding-only static evidence for GitHub-backed skills remain reviewer-only ClawScan input, or may it set public suspicious visibility for otherwise installable skills?
rationale: The diff changes the security boundary between deterministic static findings, final worker-backed ClawScan verdicts, and public catalog visibility, which needs maintainer policy intent.

options.title: Keep Evidence Reviewer-Only
options.body: Route padding findings through the current durable ClawScan flow and retain evidence without setting public suspicious state for padding-only results.

options.title: Approve Public Suspicious Visibility
options.body: Allow padding-only evidence to hide otherwise clean GitHub-backed skills, but require explicit spec coverage, tests, and runtime proof of the user-facing impact.

options.title: Pause The Draft
options.body: Leave the PR draft or close it until maintainers sponsor the scan-boundary and visibility policy.

recommendation.title: Keep Evidence Reviewer-Only
recommendation.body: Route padding findings through the current durable ClawScan flow and retain evidence without setting public suspicious state for padding-only results.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen owns the strongest current-main history signal for the GitHub-backed ClawScan boundary and is already requested for review on the PR.
